mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS scheduleId, s.title AS title, s.location AS location, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, c.id AS calendarId, c.name AS calendarName FROM schedules s JOIN calendars c ON c.id = s.calendar_id JOIN calendar_members me ON me.calendar_id = c.id AND me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.status = 'accepted' WHERE s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR s.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY s.start_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS name, c.id AS calendarId, c.name AS calendarName FROM calendar_members me JOIN calendar_members other ON other.calendar_id = me.calendar_id AND other.status = 'accepted' JOIN users u ON u.id = other.user_id JOIN calendars c ON c.id = me.calendar_id WHERE me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.status = 'accepted' AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY u.name ASC, c.is_personal DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
